$Comment: Bram the Shepherd's daily: carrots for Santa's reindeer, given and handed in at Bram, who hands over a
bundle of snowballs in return. The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_daily_carrots. Npc binds it
to Bram by the id his placement keeps in both seasons (Harvest_Feast_Shepherd), so he offers it from
his Christmas conversation, and from his feast conversation's Christmas line while Harvest Feast's last
days still run, and CompletionDialogue plays his Christmas conversation once it is collected. It opens
once Santa's first quest is done. Repeat.Reset with Period Daily is a calendar daily: it comes back at
midnight UTC. A TURN_IN step is handed in where it is, so no report-back step is added. Wild carrots
grow in the forests of the Emerald Wilds.
It pays like Santa's dailies, through Christmas_Daily_Pay, with the snowballs and favor on Santa's
Nice List and Festival Favor on its own Rewards. The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Harvesting XP for
the carrots, waiting to be collected with the rest. The row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed
gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Daily_Carrots
